run_hydra_main: run the hydra_main function to start fairseq training with Hydra configuration and return best validation metric
run_cli_main: run the cli_main entry point to initialize Hydra config and launch fairseq distributed training
run_reset_logging: run reset_logging to clear Hydra hijacked handlers and restore standard Python logging to stdout
run_hydra_train_cli: run the hydra_train CLI module to execute fairseq training with Hydra-based configuration management
run_profiled_training: run hydra_main with profiling enabled to capture CUDA and NVTX traces during fairseq training
